comment: Shared J1939 fixtures (j1939-config), in the same form as cases-v2.json and run by the same
tests in the plugin (test/unit) and the deploy tool (tools/deploy/tests).

cases.name: j1939: protocol canopen is the default
j1939: unknown protocol
messages: networks[1]: field 'protocol' must be "canopen", "j1939" or "none"

cases.name: j1939: J1939 network with nodes
messages: networks[1]: field 'nodes' belongs to a CANopen network; a J1939 network has 'j1939'

cases.name: j1939: J1939 network with master
messages: networks[1]: field 'master' belongs to a CANopen network; a J1939 network has 'j1939'

cases.name: j1939: J1939 network with role
messages: networks[1]: field 'role' belongs to a CANopen network; a J1939 network has 'j1939'

cases.name: j1939: J1939 network without j1939
messages: networks[1]: a J1939 network needs a 'j1939' object

cases.name: j1939: CANopen network with j1939
messages: networks[0]: field 'j1939' belongs to a J1939 network ("protocol": "j1939")

cases.name: j1939: simulated J1939 network
messages: networks[1]: J1939 networks run on SocketCAN or slcan interfaces; use a vcan interface for simulation, not adapter.simulate

cases.name: j1939: shares the CANopen network's interface
messages: networks[0] (io) and networks[1] (machine) both use interface vcan0

cases.name: j1939: no ecu
messages: networks[1]: j1939: field 'ecu' is missing

cases.name: j1939: address 254
messages: networks[1]: j1939: ecu: address 254 is out of range 0..253

cases.name: j1939: NAME field out of range
messages: networks[1]: j1939: ecu: name: identity_number 2097152 is out of range 0..2097151

cases.name: j1939: range without arbitrary address capability
messages: networks[1]: j1939: ecu: address_range needs a NAME with arbitrary_address_capable true

cases.name: j1939: range upside down
messages: networks[1]: j1939: ecu: address_range [135, 128] must be [low, high] within 0..253

cases.name: j1939: state location is not a byte input
messages: networks[1]: j1939: ecu: state_location %QB200 must be a byte input (%IB)

cases.name: j1939: PGN out of range
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: pgn 262144 is out of range 0..262143 (0x3FFFF)

cases.name: j1939: PDU1 PGN with a destination byte
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: PGN 61187 (0xEF03) is a PDU1 PGN: its low byte must be 0 (the destination is given separately)

cases.name: j1939: same PGN from two sources
j1939: same PGN twice without a filter
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0] and rx[1] both receive PGN 65280 (0xFF00) with the same source filter

cases.name: j1939: source and source_name
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: give 'source' or 'source_name', not both

cases.name: j1939: source out of range
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: source 254 is out of range 0..253

cases.name: j1939: TX PGN twice
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0] and tx[1] both send PGN 65281 (0xFF01)

cases.name: j1939: destination on a PDU2 PGN
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0]: PGN 65281 (0xFF01) is a PDU2 PGN and always broadcast; remove 'destination'

cases.name: j1939: destination on a PDU1 PGN
j1939: priority out of range
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0]: priority 8 is out of range 0..7

cases.name: j1939: signal past the message length
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0]: signal Run (start bit 60, 8 bits) does not fit in 8 bytes

cases.name: j1939: message length out of range
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0]: length 1786 is out of range 1..1785

cases.name: j1939: signal length 65
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: signal Pressure: length 65 is out of range 1..64

cases.name: j1939: location too small
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: signal Pressure (16 bits) does not fit location %IB10 (8 bit)

cases.name: j1939: received signal on an output
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: signal Pressure: location %QW230 must be an input (%I)

cases.name: j1939: sent signal on an input
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0]: signal Setpoint: location %IW230 must be an output (%Q)

cases.name: j1939: overlapping signals
messages: networks[1]: j1939: rx[0]: signals Pressure and Temp overlap

cases.name: j1939: big-endian signal past the end
messages: networks[1]: j1939: tx[0]: signal Setpoint (start bit 60, 16 bits) does not fit in 8 bytes

cases.name: j1939: request period too short
messages: networks[1]: j1939: requests[0]: period_ms 50 is out of range 100..600000

cases.name: j1939: clash with a CANopen PDO
messages: networks[0] (io) node 2 (pingpong) TPDO 1 object 0x4001:0 and networks[1] (machine) PGN 65280 signal Pressure both map to %ID100

cases.name: j1939: clash inside the J1939 network
messages: networks[1] (machine) ECU address and networks[1] (machine) PGN 65280 signal Temp both map to %IB204

cases.name: j1939: protocol in a version 1 file
messages: field 'protocol' needs schema_version 2
